item.body:
### Summary
As a user, I want images in topics to load without a setting to manage, as in the legacy app, so that the settings stay short and nobody misses images because of a forgotten choice.

Milestone: **M4**. Source: operator UI comparison of 2026-11-14, capture 05 (Plus › Réglages).

### Legacy (reference `87fe0d1c`)
- The operator removed this setting from legacy on purpose, to keep the settings list reasonable.
- Legacy forces `display_images = "yes"` at every launch (`Classes/HFRplusAppDelegate.m:117-118`), so the branch that reads it (`HFRswift/Wrapped/LinkItem.m:149`) never hides an image.

### Today (SwiftHFR @ `37c099b5`)
- Réglages › Général › « Images externes » (Jamais / Wi-Fi uniquement / Toujours), `App/SwiftHFR/Settings/SettingsView.swift:97`, stored as `SettingKey.displayImages` (`App/SwiftHFR/Settings/GeneralSettingsModel.swift:52-53, 115`).
- Image policy C (GAP-056, LOT-083, LOT-107, FEAT-011): Wi-Fi auto, cellular on tap.

### Requested (operator, 2026-11-14)
- Remove the setting.
- **Always load images, cellular included**: the Wi-Fi-only and tap-to-load behaviours go with it.
- Out of scope: the privacy parts of policy C that are not about *when* to load (cookie-less image client, no private hosts) stay as they are.
- Do not add other settings in its place: the settings list stays as reviewed in legacy.

### Scope
- Drop the picker and make the reader's image mode « always ».
- Persistence: a stored `display_images` value written by an earlier build is read and ignored (no crash, no migration prompt).
- Ledger: `gap-edit` of GAP-056 in the PR's `### Ledger` section (back to legacy on when to load).

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No « Images externes » row in Réglages.
- [ ] On cellular (Network Link Conditioner or a test seam), images load without a tap.
- [ ] A build carrying a stored « never » value shows images after the update.

Related: #513 (M5 image viewer), #268.

### Decision (operator, 2026-11-14)

- **Default: always load images**, as legacy and as asked here. The main Réglages list loses the « Images externes » row.
- **The choice is kept:** the Jamais / Wi-Fi uniquement / Toujours picker moves to **Réglages › Expérimental › Chargement des images** (a sub-menu of #903, option `imageLoadingChoice`, default « Toujours »). Code under `App/SwiftHFR/Experimental/ImageLoadingChoice/`, marked `// EXPERIMENTAL(imageLoadingChoice, #902)` where it overrides the default.
- Privacy parts of policy C (cookie-less image client, no private hosts) unchanged.
- Starts after #903.

### Blocked by

- #903
